record.question: His boorish manners occasionally set his refined cousin's teeth on edge
record.explanation: Answer C: irritated. “Set someone’s teeth on edge” means irritate/annoy; “irritated” is nearest. Independent check: “Set someone’s teeth on edge” means irritate or annoy.
